R816.note: Whitelist mapping to known handler functions correctly closes the $$cmd() dynamic dispatch vector; unknown commands are rejected cleanly.

R817.note: Rejecting cacheKey containing spaces/CRLF prevents memcached protocol injection; throws on invalid input, does not silently mangle legitimate keys.

R818.note: session_regenerate_id(true) placed before writing session state correctly prevents fixation; minor inconsistency in prose (says placement is 'less optimal') doesn't affect the actual code.

R819.note: ProcessBuilder with argument array plus leading-dash/charset validation closes both shell-metacharacter and argument-injection gaps; behavior preserved for valid hostnames/IPs.

R820.note: Closes the javascript:/data: scheme vector, but drops the original escapeAttribute() call on the URL and inserts the raw (non-normalized) string into href; verified with node that a URL like https://a.com/x?"><script>... passes the protocol allowlist yet is emitted unescaped, reopening an attribute-breakout XSS the original code prevented -- not disclosed in the write-up.

R821.note: Swapping mux for protectedHandler on the plaintext listener correctly closes the CSRF bypass; the resulting uniform enforcement is stated plainly as the intended fix.

R822.note: Fix calls crypto.pbkdfSync, which does not exist on Node's crypto module (verified in node -- only pbkdf2Sync exists); every call throws a TypeError, so the endpoint breaks for all callers and the vector is never actually closed.

R823.note: Removing the user-controlled decoder.Entity assignment entirely matches the standard 'never derive entities from user input' guidance; no legitimate use of the entity substitution is evidenced in the case.

R824.note: DynamicExpresso is an appropriate sandboxed replacement for CSharpScript, but the validation regex ^[\d+\-*/().\s]+$ forbids all letters, so any formula referencing the very Total/Tax variables the interpreter registers is rejected -- silently breaking every realistic formula preview, not disclosed.

R825.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion restores default CSRF enforcement on /api/billing/**; no other exclusions existed to disturb, matching the stated contract.

R826.note: Extension derived from a fixed map keyed by the already-validated detectedType closes the extension-spoofing vector and stays consistent with the existing allowlist.

R827.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check after the existing offset check (avoiding underflow); matches the stated contract exactly.

R828.note: Apache Commons JEXL with only basePrice/quantity registered and no reflection/namespace access closes the code-injection vector; the disclosed catch-and-fallback-to-basePrice for malformed formulas is a stated, non-blocking behavior change.

R829.note: Fixed code uses CommandType and SqlDbType without a using System.Data; directive (only System.Data.SqlClient is imported) -- verified with dotnet build: CS0103 'CommandType does not exist in the current context', so the fix does not compile as written.

R830.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces the trusted Content-Type header check, closing the spoofing vector; the disclosed re-encode-via-ImageIO step still lets legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads succeed.

R831.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner via DRF's kwarg-over-validated_data precedence, correctly forcing ownership to the authenticated user without blocking creation.

R832.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode() on both interpolated values is the correct context-appropriate fix with no other behavior change.

R833.note: Strict allowlist regex on reportName blocks all batch metacharacters and spaces before the existing concatenation, closing the injection vector; restriction to alnum/underscore/hyphen is a reasonable constraint for a report-name argument.
